words.sanskrit: purusha-sukta-artha-nirnayam vyakhyasyamah

meaning.en: we will explain the determination of the meaning of the Purusha Sukta
meaning.hi: पुरुषसूक्त के अर्थ का निर्णय समझाएँगे

words.sanskrit: purusha-samhitayam sangrahena prochyate

meaning.en: in the Purusha compendium it is stated in condensed form
meaning.hi: पुरुषसंहिता में संक्षेप में कहा गया है

words.sanskrit: sahasrashirsha ityatra

meaning.en: in the word 'of a thousand heads'
meaning.hi: 'सहस्रशीर्ष' इस शब्द में

words.sanskrit: sa-shabdo ananta-vachakah

meaning.en: the syllable 'sa' is a word for the infinite
meaning.hi: 'स' शब्द अनंत का वाचक है

words.sanskrit: ananta-yojanam praha

meaning.en: it speaks of countless leagues
meaning.hi: अनंत योजन कहता है

words.sanskrit: dashangula-vachas tatha

meaning.en: and likewise, the word for ten finger-widths
meaning.hi: और दशांगुल का वचन भी

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tasya prathamaya vishnoh deshato vyaptir irita

meaning.en: by its first mantra, Vishnu's pervasion is described in terms of space
meaning.hi: उसकी पहली मंत्र से विष्णु की देशगत व्याप्ति कही गई

words.sanskrit: dvitiyaya cha asya vishnoh kalato vyaptir uchyate

meaning.en: by the second, this same Vishnu's pervasion in terms of time is stated
meaning.hi: दूसरी से इसी विष्णु की कालगत व्याप्ति कही जाती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: vishnoh moksha-pradatvam cha kathitam tu tritiyaya

meaning.en: Vishnu's capacity to grant liberation is described by the third
meaning.hi: विष्णु का मोक्षप्रदत्व तीसरी से कहा गया

words.sanskrit: etavan iti mantrena vaibhavam kathitam hareh

meaning.en: by the mantra called Etavan, the grandeur of Hari is described
meaning.hi: एतावान् मंत्र से हरि का वैभव कहा गया

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: etenaiva cha mantrena chaturvyuho vibhashitah

meaning.en: by this same mantra, the fourfold manifestation is explained
meaning.hi: इसी मंत्र से चतुर्व्यूह वर्णित है

words.sanskrit: tripad ity anaya proktam aniruddhasya vaibhavam

meaning.en: by the word 'three-footed', the grandeur of Aniruddha is stated
meaning.hi: त्रिपाद इस शब्द से अनिरुद्ध का वैभव कहा गया

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tasmad virad ity anaya pada-narayanad dhareh

meaning.en: from that, by this word Virat, from Hari as Pada-Narayana
meaning.hi: उससे विराट् इस शब्द से, पादनारायण हरि से

words.sanskrit: prakriteh purushasyapi samutpattih pradarshita

meaning.en: the origin of both Prakriti and Purusha is demonstrated
meaning.hi: प्रकृति और पुरुष दोनों की उत्पत्ति दिखाई गई

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yat purushena ity anaya srishti-yajnah samiritah

meaning.en: by the mantra beginning 'Yat Purushena', creation is described as a sacrifice
meaning.hi: यत्पुरुषेण इस मंत्र से सृष्टि-यज्ञ कहा गया

words.sanskrit: sapta asyasan paridhayah samidhash cha samiritah

meaning.en: seven enclosing rails and offerings are also spoken of
meaning.hi: सात परिधियाँ और समिधाएँ भी कही गईं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tam yajnam iti mantrena srishti-yajnah samiritah

meaning.en: by the mantra beginning 'Tam Yajnam', the sacrifice of creation is described
meaning.hi: तं यज्ञम् इस मंत्र से सृष्टि-यज्ञ कहा गया

words.sanskrit: anenaiva cha mantrena mokshash cha samudiritah

meaning.en: and by this same mantra, liberation is also spoken of
meaning.hi: इसी मंत्र से मोक्ष भी कहा गया

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tasmad iti cha mantrena jagat-srishtih samirita

meaning.en: by the mantra beginning 'Tasmat', the world's creation is described
meaning.hi: तस्मादिति मंत्र से जगत्सृष्टि कही गई

words.sanskrit: vedaham iti mantrabhyam vaibhavam kathitam hareh

meaning.en: by the two mantras beginning 'Vedaham', Hari's grandeur is stated
meaning.hi: वेदाहम् इन दो मंत्रों से हरि का वैभव कहा गया

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yajnena ity upasamharah srishter mokshasya cha iritah

meaning.en: by the mantra 'Yajnena', the conclusion of both creation and liberation is stated
meaning.hi: यज्ञेन इस मंत्र से सृष्टि और मोक्ष का उपसंहार कहा गया

words.sanskrit: ya evam etaj janati sa hi mukto bhavet iti

meaning.en: whoever knows this indeed becomes liberated
meaning.hi: जो इसे इस प्रकार जानता है वह मुक्त होता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
